text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The racing suit that had been damaged in a 
minor mishap was returned, fully repaired.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, it's perfect! You fixed it up 
flawlessly!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness it's back to normal! After 
all, it's the racing outfit we put our 
hearts into designing together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's been quite a while since the two 
of us thought up the order sheet for the 
racing silks—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Um... To be honest, I'm just 
not satisfied with this order form for my 
racing silks.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I got some advice on the design from my 
dad, too...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I've been looking at the latest sportswear 
and doing my own research!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
So, I managed to get it into shape for 
now, but something just doesn't feel 
right.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'm almost there, but... Could 
you give me some advice?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the order form in my hand, it 
was a great design that easily held its 
own against the other Umamusume's.
choice_data_list: (Still, look at it the other way around—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It feels like the kind of racing outfit 
that anyone could pull off without issue.
choice_data_list:
Maybe it's lacking what makes it uniquely 
Laurel.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: What makes me, "me"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Most Umamusume express their dreams, 
feelings—or true selves—through the design 
of their racing silks.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I see. But, hmm... what does it mean to be 
"myself"...?
choice_data_list:
When I think of Laurel, indomitable spirit 
comes to mind.

Why not pour the 'dream' you wish for into 
it?
Why not pour your desired 'dream' into it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I see. But, hmm... what does it mean to be 
"myself"...?
choice_data_list:
When I think of Laurel, indomitable spirit 
comes to mind.

Why not pour the 'dream' you wish for into 
it?
Why not pour your desired 'dream' into it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
An indomitable spirit...! Fufu, to think 
that's how you felt about me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I don't know if I'm 
truly living up to that, but still—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times she falls, she 
gets back up, never abandons hope, and 
keeps looking forward.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That kind of figure is one of the things I 
aspire to be!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "...Yes, an idea just came to me!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
An indomitable spirit... Dreaming of 
"someday," the figure of an Umamusume 
envisioning the day she blooms—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
And so, what I came up with was the Takane 
cherry blossom— which is the young cherry 
leaf emblem on the ribbon on my back!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
A late bloomer, yet— a cherry blossom 
blooming in full, undefeated glory.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "...Touching this mark gives me courage."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Even if it takes time, it doesn't matter! 
Time has nothing to do with making dreams 
come true...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I came up with this logo. 
...Fufu, it's all thanks to you, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A single petal of courage, borne upon her 
cherry blossom-colored racing silks—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt once more that I want to continue 
supporting her going forward.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: The "dream" that I desire—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, that's it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And with that, Sakura Laurel smoothly 
gilded her pen across the order form."
choice_data_list: Did you come up with something?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
My dream is... a victory that echoes 
across the whole world. And my name is 
Sakura Laurel.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
When I thought about that... a certain 
motif suddenly came to mind—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The motif I thought of back then—laurel— 
became my leg ring, didn't it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Laurel"... Also known as bay leaf, or 
sweet bay.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"A crown made from these leaves has been 
the laurel bestowed upon victors since 
ancient times, a proof of victory."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Mere, yet more. Though it may only be 
a motif—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Before the race, and right in the middle 
of it. I feel like you're pushing me 
forward from behind!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Let's do our best and seize victory 
together! Hehe."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A grand, earnest dream, borne upon her 
cherry blossom-colored racing silks—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was reminded once more of my desire to 
overcome many more races together with 
her.
